_about: Single source of truth for timing. animation.py (cameras, events, captions, titles) and tools/voiceover.py read this file. Times are seconds from the start of the video at 30 fps.

scenes.name: THE DESERT
scenes.desc: Total darkness, then first light over the Nevada desert: ridgelines and valley fog. The camera flies low over the mountains toward a distant dry lakebed and the lights of a remote airfield. Title AREA 51 - NEVADA, USA.

shots.name: desert
shots.camera: Aerial fly-over, 35 mm, gliding over a ridge then tilting down toward the lakebed and the base on its shore.

scenes.edit: Fade up from black over the first 1.5 s. Low drone, wind, a single deep pulse under the hook.

scenes.name: THE RESTRICTED BASE
scenes.desc: A recreated desert airbase beside the lakebed: a long runway, rows of hangars, a control tower, fences and guard towers, dust drifting. Then the perimeter: chain-link fence, barbed wire, a guard tower, a patrol truck on the ridge and a large RESTRICTED AREA warning sign.

shots.name: base
shots.camera: Helicopter-style flyover across the hangar line toward the runway, 28 mm, slight drift.

shots.name: sign
shots.camera: Ground level at the perimeter road: slow dolly past the fence to the big RESTRICTED AREA sign, 35 mm, dust blowing through.

scenes.edit: Hard cut on the base reveal; radio static and distant jet hum; the drone builds.

scenes.name: THE SECRET AIRCRAFT
scenes.desc: Inside a vast dark hangar. Banks of lights switch on one by one and reveal a silver U-2 with its long glider wings. Then an A-12 OXCART, black titanium, chines and inward-canted fins, emerges from the dark under a moving rim light.

shots.name: u2
shots.camera: Low dolly along the U-2's wing toward the cockpit as the overhead lights come on, 24 mm.

shots.name: a12
shots.camera: Slow arc around the A-12's nose and engine spikes, 35 mm, light raking along the chines.

scenes.edit: Each bank of lights lands on a heavy electrical clunk; hangar reverb; a rising pulse.

scenes.name: THE UFO MYSTERY
scenes.desc: Dusk: the silver U-2 crosses the desert at very high altitude, its wings catching the last sunlight, a tiny glinting shape far above any airliner. Night: a mysterious light appears low over the mountains; a lone observer by a parked pickup watches it. Then 1950s-style newspaper headlines about strange lights (illustrative).

shots.name: flight
shots.camera: Long lens from below and behind, tracking the U-2 against the dusk sky, then wide as it becomes a glinting point.

shots.name: sky
shots.camera: Low, behind the observer at the roadside; the light appears above the ridgeline and drifts.

shots.name: news
shots.camera: Top-down slide across three front pages on a dark table, 50 mm.

scenes.edit: Thin radio chatter and static; the music thins to a high tone at the light; a paper rustle into the headlines.

scenes.name: THE DECLASSIFIED FILES
scenes.desc: A dark government archive: steel shelves, light shafts from high windows. On the reading table, the CIA history of the U-2 and OXCART programs and folders stamped DECLASSIFIED; pages, a site map and photographs of the aircraft slide across.

shots.name: archive
shots.camera: Slow push down the aisle toward the reading table through the light shafts, 28 mm.

shots.name: files
shots.camera: Top-down over the table as documents and photographs slide in and settle, 40 mm.

scenes.edit: Archive air, a stamp hit on DECLASSIFIED, paper slides; the score resolves into a low pulse.

scenes.name: WHAT ARE THEY STILL HIDING?
scenes.desc: The desert at night under the stars. The camera approaches one illuminated hangar across the dark apron; light spills out through haze. The hangar doors slide shut and the light narrows to a slit and is gone. THE MYSTERY OF AREA 51. WHAT ELSE IS OUT THERE? Fade to black.

shots.name: night
shots.camera: Slow approach at ground level toward the lit hangar, 35 mm; the doors close as the camera arrives.

scenes.edit: Wind and a distant jet; the doors' rumble and a heavy final clunk; silence; the end title on black.

lines.text: For nearly sixty years, Washington wouldn't even say its name.
lines.tts: For nearly sixty years, Washington wouldn't even say its name.

lines.text: Area 51. A secret airbase beside a dry lakebed, deep in the Nevada desert.
lines.tts: Area fifty-one. A secret airbase beside a dry lakebed, deep in the Nevada desert.

lines.text: Ringed by mountains, armed patrols, and signs warning that deadly force is authorized.
lines.tts: Ringed by mountains, armed patrols, and signs warning that deadly force is authorized.

lines.text: In 1955, the CIA came here to test a secret spy plane: the U-2.
lines.tts: In nineteen fifty-five, the C.I.A. came here to test a secret spy plane: the U-two.

lines.text: Then came the A-12 Oxcart, built from titanium to fly over three times the speed of sound.
lines.tts: Then came the A-twelve Oxcart, built from titanium to fly over three times the speed of sound.

lines.text: Airline pilots began reporting silver shapes, glinting impossibly high at dusk.
lines.tts: Airline pilots began reporting silver shapes, glinting impossibly high at dusk.

lines.text: Later, the CIA admitted its spy planes caused a surge in UFO reports.
lines.tts: Later, the C.I.A. admitted its spy planes caused a surge in U.F.O. reports.

lines.text: In 2013, a declassified CIA history named Area 51. It revealed spy planes, not flying saucers.
lines.tts: In twenty thirteen, a declassified C.I.A. history named Area fifty-one. It revealed spy planes, not flying saucers.

lines.text: Most of its work is still classified. So what are they testing out there tonight?
lines.tts: Most of its work is still classified. So what are they testing out there tonight?
